items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...so is Charles Lloyd... What does that mean to you?

ctx.x: George Coleman is in the class, so is Charles Lloyd, Carla Bley, and you talked about George earlier, so it must be really exciting. What does that mean to you? The nation’s honoring you for something very...

I don’t know. It’s like a lot of people told me, it’s about time and well deserved. I agree with that. The only thing I’m annoyed about is that Down Beat hasn’t written anything about us in years and years. They’re right here in Chicago, and like they say, in your own backyard, you know.
